Maya (acct): Acme Health needs a signed subprocessor addendum + redacted dataflow PDF and CAIQ answers for key management before EOD tomorrow. They said trial traffic must stay in EU. Can we turn?

Gabe (solutions): We can deliver. Quick check: they require BYOK for the POC or is a hosted EU regional pin enough?

Ana (sec): BYOK only available for Dedicated/Private. Hosted EU pinning routes processing to eu clusters but doesn’t guarantee physical isolation. Also we redact inference payloads by default for PHI tenants.

Maya (acct): They specifically called out KMS ownership and log redaction. Need explicit language in the packet.

Nick (legal): Standard approach: we can sign the Subprocessor Schedule (DPA) within 48h. If they insist on additional attestation, Legal needs more time.

ExportBot: Latest subprocessor export: https://redwood.internal/exports/subprocessors_2026-03-08.csv (redacted).

Ana (sec): CAIQ snippets to include: "Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+; Encryption at rest: AES-256; BYOK supported for Dedicated/Private; Logs: inference payloads redacted by default; IR: 24/7 triage, 72h initial RCA for Sev1."

Gabe (solutions): I'll add a one-page DFD (redacted vendors) and a pricing appendix: Hosted EU pin = no BYOK, Dedicated w/ BYOK = ~+35% trial uplift.

Maya (acct): Action list: Gabe produce redacted DFD + pricing, Ana paste CAIQ bits, Nick confirm DPA sign-off. I’ll assemble packet and send to Acme.

Nick (legal): Approved to sign standard schedule. bespoke changes = longer review.

Ana (sec): Uploaded DFD PDF to Confluence and exported redacted packet.

Maya (acct): Sent pack to Acme; they confirmed receipt. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
